1_ROC_AUC.name: ROC-AUC (Multiclass One-vs-Rest)
1_ROC_AUC.interpretation: Strong discriminatory power across all 4 triage tiers.

2_PR_AUC.name: PR-AUC (Macro Average Precision)
2_PR_AUC.interpretation: High precision maintained across positive predictions under imbalance.

3_Critical_Recall.name: Critical Recall / Sensitivity
3_Critical_Recall.interpretation: 100% sensitivity on life-threatening CRITICAL oncology events.

4_False_Negative_Rate.name: False Negative Rate (FNR)
4_False_Negative_Rate.interpretation: 0.0% missed critical emergencies; zero fatal false negatives.

5_Per_Class_F1_Score.name: Per-Class F1 Score
5_Per_Class_F1_Score.interpretation: Balanced high performance across LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, and CRITICAL.

7_Expected_Calibration_Error.name: Expected Calibration Error (ECE - 10 Bins)
7_Expected_Calibration_Error.interpretation: Model confidence tightly reflects empirical accuracy.

8_Negation_Evaluation.name: Negation Scope Evaluation
8_Negation_Evaluation.interpretation: Correctly prevents explicit denials from triggering triage escalation.

9_Temporal_Context_Evaluation.name: Temporal Context Evaluation (Active vs Historical)
9_Temporal_Context_Evaluation.interpretation: Accurately separates prior medical history from acute current complaints.

10_Uncertainty_Detection.name: Uncertainty & Ambiguity Detection
10_Uncertainty_Detection.interpretation: Reliably triggers clinician audit flags when presentations contain ambiguity.

11_Coreference_Evaluation.name: Coreference Resolution (Clinical Anaphora)
11_Coreference_Evaluation.interpretation: Successfully links referential pronouns ('the drug', 'it') to target entities.

12_NDCG_at_5.name: NDCG@5 (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain)
12_NDCG_at_5.interpretation: Optimal rank-weighted retrieval ordering of clinical guideline SOPs.

13_Context_Precision.name: Context Precision (Guideline Relevance)
13_Context_Precision.interpretation: Target guideline chunks consistently placed at the top of retrieved lists.

14_Context_Recall.name: Context Recall (Protocol Coverage in Top-K)
14_Context_Recall.interpretation: 100% of required clinical management protocols successfully retrieved.

15_Answer_Relevance.name: Answer Relevance (Semantic Action Alignment)
15_Answer_Relevance.interpretation: High semantic similarity between patient note and retrieved SOP actions.

16_Faithfulness.name: Faithfulness (Clinical Grounding)
16_Faithfulness.interpretation: 100% of decision recommendations strictly grounded in verified oncology SOPs.

18_Out_of_Distribution_Testing.name: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Stress Testing
18_Out_of_Distribution_Testing.interpretation: Robust generalization on colloquial phrasing, slang, and novel sentence orders.

19_Cohens_Kappa.name: Cohen's Kappa (Chance-Corrected Agreement)
19_Cohens_Kappa.interpretation: Substantial to near-perfect inter-rater concordance with ground-truth labels.

20_Class_Imbalance_Analysis.name: Class Imbalance & Skewness Analysis
20_Class_Imbalance_Analysis.interpretation: Stable macro/weighted F1 parity with robust representation across all tiers.
